guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own rules in the yellow cells: the fuel cost for each km, the driver wage, the minutes late you accept, the free-delivery order value and the stall labour.
Keep Zones and Time windows up to date: the fee of each zone and the hours of each window are read by Orders, Pick-up shelf and the calculators.

Write each delivery on Deliveries with the zone, the time window, the driver, the km and the fee. The delivery flag and the fee for each km fill in, and the charts show zones, windows, weekdays and late minutes.

Write each run on Delivery runs with the stops, the km, the hours and the fees. The cost for each stop and whether the fees cover it fill in, and Driver hours shows the deliveries for each hour and the overtime.
Record every late or failed delivery on Late and failed with its reason and what was done. The cost of the redo, the credit to offer and the total loss fill in.
Use Pick-ups for the orders collected at the kitchen and Pick-up shelf for the orders waiting. The status, the hours until the slot and the balance to collect fill in.

Write each market or pop-up on Markets with the stall fee, the hours, the units brought and sold, the revenue and the costs. The profit, the sell-through (the share of what you brought that you sold) and a profit or loss flag fill in.
Plan the year on Event calendar with the stall fee and the application deadline, pack with Market packing list, and answer invitations on Pop-up requests with the break-even units.
Check Market stock plan and Market sales after each market: the leftover cost and the price for each unit show what to bring next time.
Add the vehicle costs of each month on Vehicle costs and the ratings on Delivery feedback to see the cost for each delivery and the rating trend.
Use the 14 calculators before you quote a fee, plan a route, plan market stock or decide on a stall: fee by zone, route, cost for each stop, market profit, break-even, packing and more.

Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text already written (28 messages). Read the Delivery and Markets Dashboard and Charts every week.

listing.title: Home Bakery and Cake Business Delivery, Pick-up and Markets Excel Template: Routes, Delivery Fees, Market Profit, Pop-ups
listing.headline: Get every cake to the client and know what each market really earns
listing.description:
Run the delivery, the pick-up shelf and the market stalls of a home bakery or cake studio in one Excel workbook. Deliveries lists every delivery with its zone, time window, driver, km and fee, flags the late and failed ones and shows the fee for each km. Delivery runs turn the stops, the km and the hours into the cost for each stop, so you see where the fee does not cover the cost.

Pick-ups and the Pick-up shelf track every order collected at the kitchen with its slot, its balance and the hours until the slot. Late and failed keeps the reason, the action, the cost of the redo and the credit to offer, and Delivery feedback and Driver hours show the ratings and the overtime.

Markets shows the real profit of every stall after the stall fee and the labour, with the sell-through (the share of what you brought that you sold) and a profit or loss flag. Market stock plan and Market sales show what sold and what was left, Event calendar tracks the application deadlines, Market packing list counts the items still missing and Pop-up requests give the units you must sell to break even.

14 calculators cover the fee by zone, the route, the cost for each stop, the window load, the late apology, the pick-up slots, the market stock, the market profit, the leftover, the stall fee break-even, the packing list, the driver hours, the cold items and a what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages with the details already written in.

This is part six of the Home Bakery and Cake Business suite. A standard Excel workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Money is shown in one plain currency. It helps you plan and does not promise results.

signature.why: every delivery shows its day, zone, time window, driver, km and fee, with a flag for late and failed ones

signature.why: the stops, the km between them and the minutes at each stop give the total time, the finish time and whether the run fits the driver day

signature.name: Delivery fee against real cost
signature.why: each run shows its cost for each stop against the fee collected, so a zone where the fee does not cover the cost is found

signature.name: Late and failed delivery log
signature.why: every late or failed delivery keeps its reason, the action taken, the cost of the redo and the credit to offer

signature.name: Pick-up shelf and slots
signature.why: orders waiting on the shelf show their slot, whether they are ready, the balance to collect and the hours until the slot

signature.name: Market stock planner
signature.why: the units you expect to sell and the mix of products give the units of each group to bring, with a safety share on top

signature.name: Market profit after stall fee and labour
signature.why: each market shows revenue, goods cost, stall fee and labour, then the profit, the margin and a profit or loss flag

signature.name: Sell-through and leftover cost
signature.why: units brought against sold give the sell-through and the cost of what was left, so the next stock plan is based on real sales

signature.name: Market packing list
signature.why: every item to pack for a coming market has a quantity, a person and a packed tick, and the units still missing are counted

signature.name: Pop-up request decision
signature.why: each invitation shows the units you must sell to break even and how long it has waited, so the answer is made on numbers

adds up fuel and stall fees but cannot show the cost of one delivery or the profit of one market
forgets the leftover stock and the real profit after the stall fee and the labour

messages.moment: Client: delivery on the way
messages.text: Hello {client}, your order {order_id} is on the way and we expect to arrive at {eta}. Please be ready to receive it.

messages.moment: Client: your delivery window
messages.text: Hello {client}, your delivery on {date} is in the {time_window} window. We will call before we arrive.

messages.moment: Client: we are running late
messages.text: Hello {client}, we are running {minutes_late} minutes late with your order {order_id}. We are sorry and we will be with you as soon as we can.

messages.moment: Client: we could not reach you
messages.text: Hello {client}, we tried to deliver order {order_id} and could not reach you. Please call us so we can agree a new time.

messages.moment: Client: your order is ready for pick-up
messages.text: Hello {client}, your order {order_id} is ready for pick-up on {date}.

messages.moment: Client: your pick-up slot
messages.text: Hello {client}, your pick-up slot for order {order_id} is {time_window} on {date}. Please bring the order number.

messages.moment: Client: your balance is due at pick-up
messages.text: Hello {client}, the balance of {balance_due} for order {order_id} is due when you pick it up on {date}.

messages.moment: Client: your delivery fee for the zone
messages.text: Hello {client}, the delivery fee for order {order_id} is {fee} for the {zone} zone. Please tell us if the address changes.

messages.moment: Client: sorry for the late delivery
messages.text: Hello {client}, we are sorry that order {order_id} was late. We would like to offer you a credit of {credit_due} on your next order.

messages.moment: Client: please rate your delivery
messages.text: Hello {client}, thank you for your order {order_id}. Please tell us how your delivery went, from 1 to 5.

messages.moment: Client: we will deliver on another day
messages.text: Hello {client}, we cannot deliver order {order_id} on {date}. We would like to deliver on another day. Which day suits you?

messages.moment: Client: keep your cake cool
messages.text: Hello {client}, please keep the cake from order {order_id} flat and cool until serving and take it out of the box shortly before.

messages.moment: Client: our market stall is at an event
messages.text: Hello {client}, our market stall will be at {market_event} on {market_date}. Come and say hello.

messages.moment: Client: preorder for the market
messages.text: Hello {client}, you can preorder for our stall at {market_event} on {market_date}. Reply with what you would like and we will keep it for you.

messages.moment: Driver: your route for a date
messages.text: Hello, your route for {date}: {stops} stops in the {zone} zone, about {km} km. Please check the time windows before you leave.

messages.moment: Driver: a stop was added to your run
messages.text: Hello, a stop was added to your run on {date} in the {zone} zone. You now have {stops} stops.

messages.moment: Driver: load the cake boxes first
messages.text: Hello, for the run on {date} please load the cake boxes first, flat on the van floor, and secure them before the other boxes.

messages.moment: Driver: confirm the time with the client
messages.text: Hello, please confirm the delivery time with {client} for order {order_id} before you leave. The window is {time_window} and the expected time is {eta}.

messages.moment: Driver: a delivery failed, bring it back
messages.text: Hello, the delivery of order {order_id} to {client} failed ({reason}). Please bring the order back to the kitchen.

messages.moment: Driver: the market run starts at a time
messages.text: Hello, the market run for {event} on {date} starts at {load_time}. Please be at the kitchen 15 minutes before.

messages.moment: Team: pack the market boxes tonight
messages.text: Hello, please pack the market boxes tonight for {event} on {date}. {missing} units are still missing, for example {item}.

messages.moment: Team: the pick-up shelf is full
messages.text: Hello, the pick-up shelf is full for {due_date} in the {time_window} slot. Please move orders or ask clients for another slot. Order {order_id} is waiting.

messages.moment: Team: market stock to bake for a date
messages.text: Hello, please bake {brought} units of {product} for {event} on {date}.

messages.moment: Team: a pop-up request needs your answer
messages.text: Hello, the request from {organiser} for {event} (stall fee {stall_fee}, break-even {break_even_units} units) needs your answer. It has waited {days_waiting} days.

messages.moment: Owner: the fee does not cover the cost
messages.text: Hello, the delivery fee does not cover the cost in the {zone} zone: the run on {date} cost {cost_per_stop} for each stop and the fee was {fee_per_stop}.

messages.moment: Owner: the market on a date lost money
messages.text: Hello, the market {event} on {date} lost money: profit {profit} after a stall fee of {stall_fee} and labour of {labour_cost}.

messages.moment: Owner: late deliveries rose this month
messages.text: Hello, {late_deliveries} of {deliveries} deliveries were late in the month starting {month}, a late share of {late_share}.

messages.moment: Organiser: we would like a stall
messages.text: Hello {organiser}, we would like a stall at {event} on {date_wanted}. Please tell us the stall fee, the set up time and the space.

zh.Write each delivery on Deliveries with t: 在“送货”上写下每次送货的区域、时间窗口、司机、公里数和费用。填写交付标志和每公里的费用，图表显示区域、窗口、工作日和迟到分钟。
zh.Write each run on Delivery runs with the: 写下 交货运行 上的每次跑步，包括停靠点、公里数、小时数和费用。填写每个站点的费用以及费用是否涵盖该费用，司机工作时间 显示每小时的送货量和加班费。
zh.Record every late or failed delivery on: 记录 迟到且失败 上每一次迟到或失败的递送及其原因和已完成的操作。重做的成本、提供的信用和总损失填写。
zh.Use Pick-ups for the orders collected at: 对于在厨房取货的订单使用“取餐”，对于等待的订单使用 取货货架。填写状态、截止时间和要收集的余额。
zh.Write each market or pop-up on Markets w: 在每个市场或市场上的弹出窗口中写下摊位费用、营业时间、带来和销售的单位、收入和成本。填写利润、销售量（您所售出的商品的份额）以及盈亏标志。
zh.Plan the year on Event calendar with the: 在 活动日历 计划这一年的摊位费和申请截止日期，带上 市场装箱单 打包，并在 弹出请求 带着收支平衡的单位回复邀请。
zh.Check Market stock plan and Market sales: 每次市场结束后检查市场库存计划和市场销售：剩余成本和每个单位的价格显示下次要带什么。
zh.Add the vehicle costs of each month on V: 将 车辆费用 上每个月的车辆成本和 发货反馈 上的评级相加，即可查看每次交付的成本和评级趋势。
zh.Use the 14 calculators before you quote: 在报价、规划路线、计划市场库存或决定摊位之前使用 14 个计算器：按区域、路线、每个站点的成本、市场利润、盈亏平衡、包装等。

zh.Choose a record: each step gets its due: 选择一条记录：每个步骤都会生成到期日期。每条记录请复制一份此工作表。

ru.orders waiting on the shelf show their s: заказы, ожидающие на полке, показывают их слот, готовы ли они, баланс, который нужно получить, и часы до слота

ru.Delivery feedback with a low rating flag: Отзыв о доставке с пометкой низкого рейтинга
ru.One row for each rating a client gave a: Одна строка для каждой оценки, которую клиент поставил с комментарием; загорается флаг низкого рейтинга, поэтому на той же неделе отслеживается плохая поставка.

ru.Check the cake boxes and the cool boxes: Проверьте коробки для тортов и охлаждающие коробки.
ru.Open the box with the client and show th: Откройте коробку вместе с клиентом и покажите торт.
ru.Tell the client how to keep the cake coo: Расскажите клиенту, как сохранить торт прохладным.
ru.Bring the order back and put it in the f: Верните заказ и поставьте его в холодильник.
ru.Decide on a credit or a refund: Примите решение о кредите или возврате средств
ru.Put a label with the name and the slot o: Наклейте этикетку с названием и слотом на каждый заказ.
ru.Keep the items that need the fridge in t: Храните в холодильнике те продукты, которые нуждаются в хранении в холодильнике.
ru.Write the balance on the label if one is: Напишите остаток на этикетке, если он подлежит оплате.
ru.Load the van in the order you unload: Загрузите фургон в том порядке, в котором вы его разгружаете.
ru.Tick every item before you leave: Прежде чем уйти, отметьте каждый пункт

ru.Check that the team is free that day: Проверьте, свободна ли команда в этот день
ru.Ask the organiser about the space and th: О месте и времени установки уточните у организатора.

ru.Check the late and failed deliveries and: Проверьте просроченные и неудачные поставки и их причины.

ru.Pick-ups collected on the day: Пикапы собраны в тот же день

ru.Open Start and type your company name an: Откройте «Пуск» и введите название вашей компании и свои собственные правила в желтые ячейки: стоимость топлива за каждый км, зарплату водителя, количество минут опоздания, которое вы принимаете, стоимость заказа на бесплатную доставку и работу ларька.
ru.Keep Zones and Time windows up to date:: Поддерживайте актуальными зоны и временные окна: стоимость зоны и часы окна считываются листами «Заказы», «Полка самовывоза» и калькуляторами.
ru.Write each delivery on Deliveries with t: Напишите каждую доставку в разделе «Доставки» с указанием зоны, временного окна, водителя, километража и стоимости. Заполняется флажок доставки и плата за каждый км, а на графиках отображаются зоны, окна, дни недели и минуты опоздания.
ru.Write each run on Delivery runs with the: Запишите каждый забег на Доставка осуществляется с указанием остановок, километров, часов и стоимости. Заполните стоимость каждой остановки и укажите, покрывают ли ее сборы, а в Часы работы водителя показаны поставки за каждый час и сверхурочные часы.
ru.Record every late or failed delivery on: Записывайте каждую задержку или неудачную доставку на Поздно и неудачно с указанием причины и того, что было сделано. Заполните стоимость переделки, предлагаемый кредит и общую сумму убытков.
ru.Use Pick-ups for the orders collected at: Используйте Самовывоз для заказов, собранных на кухне, и Полка для пикапа для ожидающих заказов. Статус, часы до заполнения слота и баланс для получения.
ru.Write each market or pop-up on Markets w: Напишите каждый рынок или всплывающее окно на рынках с указанием платы за киоск, часов, доставленных и проданных единиц, доходов и затрат. Заполняется прибыль, сквозная продажа (доля того, что вы принесли, которую вы продали) и флажок прибыли или убытка.
ru.Plan the year on Event calendar with the: Запланируйте год на Календарь событий с учетом платы за палатку и крайнего срока подачи заявок, упакуйте с Упаковочный лист рынка и ответьте на приглашения на Всплывающие запросы с единицами безубыточности.
ru.Check Market stock plan and Market sales: Проверяйте План рыночных акций и Рыночные продажи после каждого рынка: оставшаяся стоимость и цена за каждую единицу показывают, что взять с собой в следующий раз.
ru.Add the vehicle costs of each month on V: Добавьте ежемесячную стоимость транспортных средств в Стоимость автомобиля и рейтинги в Отзыв о доставке, чтобы увидеть стоимость каждой доставки и динамику рейтинга.
ru.Use the 14 calculators before you quote: Используйте 14 калькуляторов, прежде чем назначать плату, планировать маршрут, планировать рыночный запас или принимать решение о ларьке: плата за зону, маршрут, стоимость каждой остановки, рыночная прибыль, безубыточность, упаковка и многое другое.
ru.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Распечатайте 10 листов и 10 документов, следуйте 10 контрольным спискам и коснитесь ссылки на сообщение, чтобы открыть чат с уже написанным текстом (28 сообщений). Читайте Панель доставки и рынков и графики каждую неделю.
ru.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Все выпадающие списки книги. Измените пункт здесь — он обновится на всех листах.
ru.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Данные обновляются по вашим листам. Измените год, чтобы посмотреть прошлые периоды.
ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
ru.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Измените текст здесь; слова в скобках подставляются из каждой строки. Ссылки находятся в таблицах.
ru.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Выберите запись — для каждого этапа появится срок. Создайте копию листа для каждой записи.
ru.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Актуальные диаграммы по данным ваших листов. Выберите значения в жёлтых ячейках — диаграммы и индикаторы обновятся автоматически.

fr.Delivery stops one time window can take: La livraison s'arrête une fenêtre de temps peut prendre
fr.Pick-ups one time window can take: Les ramassages peuvent prendre une seule fenêtre horaire
fr.Delivery rating you want to keep: Note de livraison que vous souhaitez conserver
fr.Cake needed a repair: Le gâteau a dû être réparé
fr.Stall made a profit: Le stand a fait un bénéfice
fr.Deliveries by day, zone and time window: Livraisons par jour, zone et plage horaire

fr.Delivery runs with the cost for each sto: Les livraisons avec le coût de chaque arrêt
fr.One row for each run of a driver in one: Une ligne pour chaque parcours d'un conducteur dans une zone avec les arrêts, les km, les heures et les redevances perçues ; le coût de la course, le coût de chaque arrêt et si les frais le couvrent.
fr.Delivery zones with the fee and the dist: Zones de livraison avec les frais et la distance
fr.The five delivery zones with the fee you: Les cinq zones de livraison avec les frais que vous facturez et la distance par rapport à la cuisine ; l'outil de frais et les commandes lisent les frais à partir d'ici.
fr.Time windows with the start and the end: Fenêtres horaires avec l'heure de début et de fin
fr.The four delivery and pick-up windows wi: Les quatre fenêtres de livraison et de retrait avec l'heure de début et de fin de chacune d'entre elles ; l'étagère de pick-up lit l'heure de départ à partir d'ici.
fr.Pick-ups with the time window and the ba: Enlèvements avec le créneau horaire et le solde dû
fr.One row for each order collected at the: Une ligne pour chaque commande retirée en cuisine avec le créneau horaire, le solde restant à payer et le jour du retrait ; le statut de retrait se remplit, donc une commande non récupérée ressort.
fr.Orders to deliver or collect: Commandes à livrer ou à retirer
fr.The orders due in the last and the next: Les commandes à rendre la semaine dernière et les semaines suivantes avec la façon dont elles quittent la cuisine ; les frais de livraison à facturer se remplissent depuis la zone.
fr.Pick-up shelf with the hours to the slot: Tablette de ramassage avec les heures du créneau
fr.One row for each order waiting on the sh: Une rangée pour chaque commande en attente en rayon avec son emplacement, si elle est prête et le solde à récupérer ; les heures jusqu'au début du créneau se remplissent.
fr.Late and failed deliveries with the cost: En retard et en échec livraisons avec le coût de la refaire
fr.One row for each late or failed delivery: Une ligne pour chaque livraison en retard ou en échec avec la raison, ce qui a été fait et la valeur de la commande ; le coût de la refaire, le crédit à proposer et la perte totale comblent.
fr.Markets and pop-ups with profit after st: Marchés et pop-ups : bénéfice après stand et main-d'œuvre
fr.One row for each market or pop-up with t: Une ligne pour chaque marché ou pop-up avec les frais de stand, les heures, les unités, les revenus et les coûts ; le profit, la vente (la part de ce que vous avez apporté et que vous avez vendu) et un indicateur de profit ou de perte sont complétés.
fr.Market stock plan with sell-through and: Plan de stock de marché avec vente directe et coût restant
fr.One row for each market with the main pr: Une rangée pour chaque marché avec le produit principal apporté et vendu ; les unités restantes, les ventes et le coût des restes sont pris en compte, de sorte que le prochain plan de stock est basé sur ce qui a été vendu.
fr.Market sales by product: Ventes sur le marché par produit
fr.One row for each product sold at a marke: Une ligne pour chaque produit vendu sur un marché avec les unités et le chiffre d'affaires ; le prix de chaque unité est renseigné, vous voyez donc ce qui se vend sur quel stand.

fr.One row for each market, fair or pop-up: Une ligne pour chaque marché, salon ou pop-up que vous envisagez, avez postulé ou réalisé, avec les frais d'exposition, la date limite d'inscription et le statut ; les jours jusqu'à l'événement et le drapeau de date limite sont remplis.
fr.Market packing list with the items missi: Liste de colisage du marché avec les éléments manquants
fr.One row for each item to pack for a comi: Une ligne pour chaque article à emballer pour un marché à venir avec la quantité, qui l'emballe et s'il est emballé ; l'événement, sa date et les unités encore manquantes complètent.
fr.Pop-up requests with the break-even unit: Demandes pop-up avec les unités d'équilibre
fr.One row for each invitation to run a sta: Une ligne pour chaque invitation à tenir un stand avec l'organisateur, la date souhaitée, le tarif du stand et les horaires ; les unités que vous devez vendre pour atteindre le seuil de rentabilité et les jours d'attente d'une réponse se remplissent.
fr.Vehicle costs with the cost for each del: Frais de véhicule avec le coût de chaque livraison
fr.One row for each month with the fuel and: Une ligne pour chaque mois avec le carburant et le stationnement, l'entretien et les livraisons effectuées ; renseignez le coût du véhicule et le coût de chaque livraison.
fr.Delivery feedback with a low rating flag: Retours livraison avec alerte de note faible
fr.One row for each rating a client gave a: Une ligne pour chaque note qu'un client a donnée avec le commentaire ; le drapeau de mauvaise note se remplit, donc une mauvaise livraison est suivie la même semaine.
fr.Driver hours with the deliveries for eac: Heures de conduite avec les livraisons pour chaque heure
fr.One row for each day a driver worked wit: Une ligne pour chaque jour travaillé par un chauffeur avec les heures et les livraisons effectuées ; les livraisons pour chaque heure et un indicateur d'heures supplémentaires sont remplis.
fr.Clients with zone and the market they li: Clients avec zone et marché à proximité duquel ils habitent
fr.The clients who order most with their ph: Les clients qui commandent le plus avec leur téléphone, leur zone et leur dernière commande, ainsi que le stand de marché le plus proche d'eux, afin qu'un message sur un stand parvienne aux bonnes personnes.
fr.Products with pack, shelf days, price an: Produits avec emballage, jours de conservation, prix et coût
fr.The 24 products with the pack, how long: Les 24 produits du pack, leur durée de conservation, le prix et le coût des ingrédients et de l'emballage d'une unité ; les tables du marché lisent le coût à partir d'ici.
fr.The owner, the bakers, the decorators, t: Le propriétaire, les boulangers, les décorateurs, le préposé aux commandes, le chauffeur et les contacts extérieurs avec téléphone, horaires hebdomadaires et tarif horaire.

es.Pack the table, the cover and the signs: Empaca la mesa, la funda y los carteles.
es.Check the cash box and the card reader: Consulta la caja y el lector de tarjetas.
es.Charge the phone and the card reader: Cargar el teléfono y el lector de tarjetas.
es.Load the van in the order you unload: Carga la furgoneta en el orden de descarga.
es.Tick every item before you leave: Marque cada elemento antes de partir
es.Arrive early and find the stall: Llega temprano y encuentra el puesto.
es.Set up the table and the cover: Colocar la mesa y la cubierta.
es.Put the price signs where clients see th: Coloque los carteles de precios donde los vean los clientes.
es.Put the stock out with the best sellers: Sacar el stock con los más vendidos al frente
es.Put a sample plate out if you have one: Coloque un plato de muestra si tiene uno.
es.Write the opening time and the stock: Escribe el horario de apertura y el stock.
es.Count the units left over of each produc: Contar las unidades sobrantes de cada producto.
es.Count the cash and the card sales: Cuente el efectivo y las ventas con tarjeta.
es.Write the revenue on the market result s: Escriba los ingresos en la hoja de resultados del mercado.
es.Pack the unsold stock for the next day o: Empacar el stock no vendido para el día siguiente o para el equipo.
es.Clean the stall and take everything back: Limpia el puesto y recupera todo.
es.Write what sold out first: Escribe primero lo que se agotó
es.Decide if the stall is worth repeating: Decide si vale la pena repetir el puesto
es.Read the request and the date wanted: Leer la solicitud y la fecha deseada.
es.Check the break-even units against the e: Comparar las unidades de equilibrio con las ventas esperadas.
es.Check that the team is free that day: Comprueba que el equipo está libre ese día.
es.Ask the organiser about the space and th: Pregunta al organizador sobre el espacio y el tiempo de montaje.
es.Add an accepted event to the event calen: Agregar un evento aceptado al calendario de eventos
es.Check the late and failed deliveries and: Consulta las entregas tardías y fallidas y sus motivos.
es.Compare the vehicle cost with the fees: Compare el costo del vehículo con las tarifas.
es.Read the low ratings and call the client: Lea las calificaciones bajas y llame a los clientes.
es.Check the driver hours and the overtime: Consulta las horas del conductor y las horas extras.
es.Check the fee of each zone against its c: Consulta la tarifa de cada zona contra su coste
es.Write one change for the next month: Escribe un cambio para el próximo mes.
es.Orders by fulfil type per month: Pedidos por tipo de cumplimiento por mes
es.Open Start and type your company name an: Abre Inicio y escribe el nombre de tu empresa y tus propias reglas en las celdas amarillas: el coste del combustible por cada kilómetro, el salario del conductor, los minutos de retraso que aceptas, el valor del pedido de entrega gratuita y la mano de obra del puesto.
es.Keep Zones and Time windows up to date:: Mantener Zonas y Ventanas de tiempo actualizadas: la tarifa de cada zona y los horarios de cada ventana son leídos por Órdenes, estante para recoger y las calculadoras.
es.Write each delivery on Deliveries with t: Escribe cada entrega en Entregas con la zona, la ventana horaria, el conductor, los kilómetros y la tarifa. Se completan la bandera de entrega y la tarifa por cada kilómetro, y los gráficos muestran zonas, ventanas, días laborables y minutos de retraso.
es.Write each run on Delivery runs with the: Escribe cada recorrido en Ejecuciones de entrega con las paradas, los km, las horas y las tarifas. Se completa el costo de cada parada y si las tarifas lo cubren, y Horas del conductor muestra las entregas por cada hora y las horas extras.
es.Record every late or failed delivery on: Registre cada entrega tardía o fallida el Tarde y fallido con su motivo y lo que se hizo. Se completan el costo de la rehacer, el crédito a ofrecer y la pérdida total.
es.Use Pick-ups for the orders collected at: Utilice Recogidas para los pedidos recogidos en cocina y estante para recoger para los pedidos en espera. Se completa el estado, las horas hasta la franja horaria y el saldo a cobrar.
es.Write each market or pop-up on Markets w: Escriba cada mercado o ventana emergente en Mercados con la tarifa del puesto, el horario, las unidades traídas y vendidas, los ingresos y los costos. La ganancia, la venta directa (la parte de lo que trajo y que vendió) y una bandera de ganancias o pérdidas se completan.
es.Plan the year on Event calendar with the: Planifique el año el Calendario de eventos con la tarifa del puesto y la fecha límite de solicitud, empaquete con Lista de embalaje del mercado y responda las invitaciones el Solicitudes emergentes con las unidades de equilibrio.
es.Check Market stock plan and Market sales: Verifique plan de acciones de mercado y Ventas de mercado después de cada mercado: el costo sobrante y el precio de cada unidad muestran qué traer la próxima vez.
es.Add the vehicle costs of each month on V: Agregue los costos de los vehículos de cada mes en Costos del vehículo y las calificaciones en Comentarios de entrega para ver el costo de cada entrega y la tendencia de calificación.
es.Use the 14 calculators before you quote: Utilice las 14 calculadoras antes de cotizar una tarifa, planificar una ruta, planificar las existencias del mercado o decidirse por un puesto: tarifa por zona, ruta, costo de cada parada, ganancia del mercado, punto de equilibrio, embalaje y más.
es.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Imprima 10 hojas y 10 documentos, siga 10 listas de verificación y toque el enlace de un mensaje para abrir un chat con el texto ya escrito (28 mensajes). Lea el Panel de entrega y mercados y los gráficos cada semana.
es.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Todas las listas desplegables del archivo. Cambia aquí el nombre de un elemento y se actualizará en todas las hojas.
es.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Se actualiza con los datos de tus hojas. Cambia el año para consultar años anteriores.
es.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Elige en la celda amarilla; el resto se completa automáticamente. Listo para imprimir.
es.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Edita aquí el texto; las palabras entre {llaves} se completan con los datos de cada fila. Los enlaces están en las tablas.
es.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Elige un registro: cada paso tendrá su fecha límite. Haz una copia de esta hoja para cada caso.
es.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Gráficos actualizados con los datos de tus hojas. Elige en las celdas amarillas y los gráficos e indicadores se actualizarán automáticamente.

de.Type the km, the minutes the run takes,: Geben Sie die km, die Laufminuten, die Treibstoff- und Lohnsätze sowie die von Ihnen erhobene Gebühr ein; Sehen Sie sich die Kosten für die Fahrt, die Kosten für jeden Stopp und die Marge der Gebühr an.

de.Keep Zones and Time windows up to date:: Halten Sie Zonen und Zeitfenster auf dem neuesten Stand: Die Gebühr für jede Zone und die Stunden jedes Fensters werden von Orders, Abholregal und den Rechnern abgelesen.

de.Write each run on Delivery runs with the: Schreiben Sie jede Fahrt auf Lieferung läuft mit den Stopps, den Kilometern, den Stunden und den Gebühren. Geben Sie die Kosten für jeden Stopp ein und ob die Gebühren diese decken. Fahrerstunden zeigt die Lieferungen für jede Stunde und die Überstunden an.
de.Record every late or failed delivery on: Erfassen Sie jede verspätete oder fehlgeschlagene Zustellung am Zu spät und gescheitert mit Angabe des Grundes und der durchgeführten Maßnahmen. Die Kosten für die Wiederherstellung, der anzubietende Kredit und der Gesamtverlust sind einzutragen.
de.Use Pick-ups for the orders collected at: Verwenden Sie „Abholung“ für die in der Küche abgeholten Bestellungen und Abholregal für die wartenden Bestellungen. Der Status, die Stunden bis zum Slot und der einzusammelnde Restbetrag werden ausgefüllt.
de.Write each market or pop-up on Markets w: Beschreiben Sie jeden Markt oder jedes Pop-up auf „Märkte“ mit der Standgebühr, den Stunden, den mitgebrachten und verkauften Einheiten, den Einnahmen und den Kosten. de.Plan the year on Event calendar with the: Planen Sie das Jahr am Veranstaltungskalender mit der Standgebühr und der Anmeldefrist, packen Sie mit Packliste für den Markt und beantworten Sie Einladungen am Popup-Anfragen mit den Break-Even-Einheiten.

de.Add the vehicle costs of each month on V: Fügen Sie die Fahrzeugkosten jedes Monats auf Fahrzeugkosten und die Bewertungen auf Rückmeldung zur Lieferung hinzu, um die Kosten für jede Lieferung und den Bewertungstrend anzuzeigen.
de.Use the 14 calculators before you quote: Nutzen Sie die 14 Rechner, bevor Sie eine Gebühr angeben, eine Route planen, den Marktbestand planen oder sich für einen Stand entscheiden: Gebühr nach Zone, Route, Kosten für jeden Stopp, Marktgewinn, Break-Even, Verpackung und mehr.
de.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 10 Dokumente aus, befolgen Sie 10 Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um einen Chat mit dem bereits geschriebenen Text zu öffnen (28 Nachrichten). it.Vehicle costs with the cost for each del: Costi del veicolo con il costo per ogni consegna
it.One row for each month with the fuel and: Una riga per ogni mese con il carburante e il parcheggio, la manutenzione e le consegne effettuate; compilare il costo del veicolo e il costo per ogni consegna.
it.Delivery feedback with a low rating flag: Feedback consegna con avviso di valutazione bassa

it.Driver hours with the deliveries for eac: Ore di guida con le consegne per ogni ora

pt.Add an accepted event to the event calen: Adicione um evento aceito ao calendário de eventos
pt.Check the late and failed deliveries and: Verifique as entregas atrasadas e falhadas e seus motivos
pt.Compare the vehicle cost with the fees: Compare o custo do veículo com as taxas
pt.Read the low ratings and call the client: Leia as classificações baixas e ligue para os clientes
pt.Check the driver hours and the overtime: Verifique as horas do motorista e as horas extras
pt.Check the fee of each zone against its c: Verifique a taxa de cada zona em relação ao seu custo
pt.Write one change for the next month: Escreva uma alteração para o próximo mês
pt.Orders by fulfil type per month: Pedidos por tipo de atendimento por mês
pt.Open Start and type your company name an: Abra Start e digite o nome da sua empresa e suas próprias regras nas células amarelas: o custo do combustível por cada km, o salário do motorista, os minutos de atraso que você aceita, o valor do pedido com entrega gratuita e a mão de obra da barraca.
pt.Keep Zones and Time windows up to date:: Mantenha as Zonas e Janelas de tempo atualizadas: a taxa de cada zona e os horários de cada janela são lidos pelos Pedidos, Prateleira de coleta e pelas calculadoras.
pt.Write each delivery on Deliveries with t: Escreva cada entrega em Entregas com a zona, a janela de horário, o motorista, o km e a taxa. A bandeira de entrega e a taxa por km são preenchidas e os gráficos mostram zonas, janelas, dias da semana e minutos de atraso.
pt.Write each run on Delivery runs with the: Escreva cada corrida em Execuções de entrega com as paradas, os km, as horas e as taxas. Preencha o custo de cada parada e se as taxas cobrem, e Horas do motorista mostra as entregas de cada hora e as horas extras.
pt.Record every late or failed delivery on: Registre cada entrega atrasada ou com falha em Atrasado e falhado com o motivo e o que foi feito. O custo do refazer, o crédito a oferecer e a perda total são preenchidos.
pt.Use Pick-ups for the orders collected at: Utilize Pick-ups para os pedidos coletados na cozinha e Prateleira de coleta para os pedidos em espera. O status, as horas até a vaga e o saldo a cobrar são preenchidos.
pt.Write each market or pop-up on Markets w: Escreva cada mercado ou pop-up em Mercados com a taxa da barraca, os horários, as unidades trazidas e vendidas, as receitas e os custos. O lucro, a venda por distribuidores (a parcela do que você trouxe e vendeu) e um sinalizador de lucro ou perda são preenchidos.
pt.Plan the year on Event calendar with the: Planeje o ano em Calendário de eventos com a taxa de barraca e o prazo de inscrição, faça a mala com Lista de embalagem do mercado e responda aos convites em Solicitações pop-up com as unidades de equilíbrio.
pt.Check Market stock plan and Market sales: Verifique Plano de ações de mercado e Vendas de mercado após cada mercado: o custo restante e o preço de cada unidade mostram o que levar na próxima vez.
pt.Add the vehicle costs of each month on V: Adicione os custos dos veículos de cada mês em Custos do veículo e as classificações em Feedback de entrega para ver o custo de cada entrega e a tendência das classificações.
pt.Use the 14 calculators before you quote: Use as 14 calculadoras antes de cotar uma taxa, planejar uma rota, planejar ações de mercado ou decidir sobre uma barraca: taxa por zona, rota, custo para cada parada, lucro de mercado, ponto de equilíbrio, embalagem e muito mais.
pt.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Imprima 10 folhas e 10 documentos, siga 10 checklists e toque no link de uma mensagem para abrir um chat com o texto já escrito (28 mensagens). Leia o Painel de entrega e mercados e os gráficos todas as semanas.
pt.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Todas as listas suspensas deste arquivo. Renomeie uma opção aqui e ela será atualizada em todas as planilhas.
pt.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Atualiza automaticamente com os dados das planilhas. Altere o ano para consultar anos anteriores.
pt.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Escolha na célula amarela; o restante é preenchido automaticamente. Pronto para imprimir.
pt.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Edite o texto aqui; o conteúdo entre {chaves} é preenchido com os dados de cada linha. Os links estão nas tabelas.
pt.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Escolha um registro: cada etapa recebe uma data prevista. Faça uma cópia desta planilha para cada registro.
pt.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Gráficos atualizados com os dados das planilhas. Escolha nas células amarelas para atualizar gráficos e indicadores.

nl.One row for each invitation to run a sta: Eén rij voor elke uitnodiging om een kraam te runnen met de organisator, de gewenste datum, het standgeld en de uren; de eenheden die je moet verkopen om break-even te draaien en de dagen die wachten op een antwoord worden ingevuld.
nl.Vehicle costs with the cost for each del: Voertuigkosten met de kosten voor elke bezorging
nl.One row for each month with the fuel and: Eén rij per maand met de brandstof en parkeren, het onderhoud en de gedane leveringen; vul de voertuigkosten en de kosten voor elke levering in.
nl.Delivery feedback with a low rating flag: Feedback over levering met een lage beoordelingsvlag
